sources: Nemesis: Lockdown rules (Awaken Realms, via RulesPal)
Nemesis: Lockdown rules summary (Esoteric Order of Gamers, v2)

modules.name: Fully cooperative mode
modules.note: All Objectives are public and must all be fulfilled; at least 1 Character must survive.

steps.text: Board on its basic side (red arrow, top left)
Isolation Room (room-action side down), Repository and Backup Power Supply on their slots
Shuffle the II room tiles facedown, 1 per II slot (6 of 9 used); then the I tiles on the I slots
1 random facedown Underground Exploration token on each unrevealed room
Elevator, Main Gate and Rover in their places
Power tokens: 3 in the section slots, 1 on the Elevator; 1 and 2 blue side up, 3 and 4 red side up
1 CSS token facedown on each CSS slot of the time track; box the extra
Time token red (inactive) side up on the 15th (green) space; Alert, Autodestruction and Venting tokens nearby
Laboratory board: 5 Egg tokens in the Nest; 3 random Weakness cards, the leftmost revealed
Intruder bag: 1 Blank, 4 Larvae, 1 Creeper, 1 Queen, {n} Adults
Spare Intruder and Carcass tokens beside the board
Shuffle the red, yellow and green Item decks; crafted item deck beside them
steps.ref: Setup (Summary) / Esoteric Order of Gamers Lockdown summary v2, Setup

steps.text: Shuffle the Night Stalker Event and Attack decks, Contamination and Serious Wound decks; scanner by Contamination
steps.ref: Setup (Summary) / Esoteric Order of Gamers Lockdown summary v2, Setup

steps.text: Computer deck facedown on its slot; reveal the top card (Lock-down: reveal the next, shuffle Lock-down back in)
steps.ref: Setup (Summary) / Esoteric Order of Gamers Lockdown summary v2, Setup

steps.text: Each player: a Help card (draft order and player number) and an Inventory holder
Deal each player 1 Corporate and 1 Personal Objective, secret (first remove ones needing more players)
Draw 2 Solo/Coop Objectives; keep 1 after the first Encounter
1 Solo/Coop Objective per player, all faceup
Deal each player {n} secret Contingency; 1 facedown on the Active Contingency slot, the rest in the Neutral Pool
1 Contingency on the Active slot, the rest in the Neutral Pool; then draw 2 from the Neutral Pool
Draft: in player order draw 2 Draft cards, keep 1, shuffle the other back
Take your Character board, miniature, shuffled Action deck, Starting Item (with ammo) and Quest Item facedown
Nemesis Survivors start in the Isolation Room, Facility Workers in the Repository
Knowledge token inactive side up on the Laboratory board: slot 1 for Facility Workers, slot 3 for Survivors
Each round draw up to 5 Action cards
At the first Intruder appearance everyone discards 1 Objective facedown
Solo: items per room are halved (round up)
Ending a turn in a room with Fire costs 1 Light Wound
To win you must fulfil your Objective and survive: Isolation Room, CSS pod or the Bunker
Player 1 takes the First Player token
